boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Rhode Island
boards.description: Ten food-focused destinations on or immediately beside URI’s Kingston campus with currently published evening availability.

cards.title: Rhody Market
cards.subtitle: Mainfare Dining Hall, Hope Commons
cards.notes: Place a Grubhub pickup order for the published late-night window; in-person ordering is not available at this Hope Commons location.
cards.short_summary: A mobile-order late-night counter inside Hope Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: URI Dining lists Rhody Market’s late-night service from 8–10:30 p.m. on Monday, Tuesday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Current Fall ’26 hours list service 8–10:30 p.m. Monday, Tuesday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday; mobile Grubhub pickup only.

cards.title: Rams Den
cards.subtitle: URI retail food court
cards.notes: Use the Wednesday or Thursday late-night service window and confirm the active station menu before heading over.
cards.short_summary: URI’s food court has two designated late-night evenings.
cards.evidence_claim: URI Dining identifies Wednesday and Thursday as Rams Den late nights, with service continuing until 10:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Current Fall ’26 listing: Wednesday and Thursday late nights run 5:30–10:30 p.m.; meal swipes are available during after-hours service only.

cards.title: The Corner Store
cards.subtitle: URI campus retail market
cards.notes: Stop in for packaged food, snacks, sandwiches, or supplies before the listed 10:30 p.m. close; payment options are posted by URI.
cards.short_summary: A campus market open into the evening every day.
cards.evidence_claim: URI Dining lists The Corner Store open 9 a.m.–10:30 p.m. Sunday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: The Corner Store – URI Dining Services
cards.access_notes: Current Fall ’26 hours are 9 a.m.–10:30 p.m. daily.

cards.title: Mainfare Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Top floor of Hope Commons
cards.notes: Plan for the posted dinner period and dine in; only the Fusion station offers mobile to-go orders during its separate schedule.
cards.short_summary: The all-you-care-to-eat Hope Commons dining hall serves dinner until 9 p.m. on select days.
cards.evidence_claim: URI Dining lists Mainfare dinner through 9 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday during Fall ’26.
cards.source_title: Mainfare Dining Hall – URI Dining Services
cards.access_notes: Current Fall ’26 dinner hours: until 9 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday; until 8 p.m. Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: Daily Grind
cards.subtitle: URI Library main lobby
cards.notes: Use the library-lobby cafe on a weekday evening; place the order in Grubhub because this location does not take in-person orders.
cards.short_summary: A library-lobby cafe with weekday service until 8 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: URI Dining lists Daily Grind open Monday–Thursday from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. and states that ordering is through Grubhub.
cards.access_notes: Current Fall ’26 hours: Monday–Thursday until 8 p.m.; mobile ordering only.

cards.title: IZone
cards.subtitle: 100 Fortin Road, Kingston
cards.notes: Check the online ordering page before leaving; it lists carryout and delivery and publishes a 1:30 a.m. end time.
cards.short_summary: A Fortin Road restaurant with service deep into the night.
cards.evidence_claim: IZone’s official site lists its Kingston address near URI and business hours of 5 p.m.–1:30 a.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 5 p.m.–1:30 a.m. daily; carryout is listed until 1:30 a.m. Monday–Thursday, with Friday and Saturday beginning at noon.

cards.title: Kingston Pizza — URI
cards.subtitle: 63 Briar Lane, Kingston
cards.notes: Use the URI location’s ordering or phone options and allow time before its posted 11 p.m. close during the September–May schedule.
cards.short_summary: A Briar Lane pizza stop beside campus with an 11 p.m. academic-year close.
cards.evidence_claim: Kingston Pizza’s official contact page lists the URI location at 63 Briar Lane and September–May hours of 11 a.m.–11 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Official September–May schedule lists the URI location open daily until 11 p.m.; when URI is closed, it lists a 10 p.m. close.

cards.title: The Rhode House
cards.subtitle: 99 Fortin Road, Suite 116
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s official ordering page to confirm availability; its published weekday schedule runs later than the weekend schedule.
cards.short_summary: A Fortin Road food stop open until 11 p.m. on weekdays.
cards.evidence_claim: The Rhode House’s official Toast ordering page lists 99 Fortin Road, Kingston and hours until 11 p.m. Monday–Friday.
cards.source_title: The Rhode House – Official Online Ordering
cards.access_notes: Official ordering page lists noon–11 p.m. Monday–Friday; weekend hours end at 10 p.m.

cards.title: PVD Pizza Kingston — URI
cards.subtitle: 99 Fortin Road, Kingston
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s official order page and choose pickup; the listed Thursday through Saturday schedule extends to 2 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A Fortin Road pizza counter with midnight and 2 a.m. ordering windows.
cards.evidence_claim: PVD Pizza’s official Toast ordering page lists its 99 Fortin Road location open until midnight Sunday–Wednesday and until 2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: PVD Pizza Kingston – URI – Official Online Ordering
cards.access_notes: Official ordering page lists 10:45 a.m.–midnight Sunday–Wednesday and 10:45 a.m.–2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.

cards.title: Caliente Mexican Grill — URI
cards.subtitle: 99 Fortin Road, Kingston
cards.notes: Use the URI location’s official order link or phone line and aim to arrive before its posted 11 p.m. closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Fortin Road grill beside the URI Quad, open until 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Caliente Mexican Grill’s URI location page identifies 99 Fortin Road next to the URI Quad and lists hours ending at 11 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Official URI location hours: 10 a.m.–11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11 a.m.–11 p.m. Friday–Saturday.
